collective_defence.name: Collective defence treaty
collective_defence.description: Members undertake to defend a member attacked from outside. Admission and grants require unanimity. Civil wars and members' own offensives are not covered.

development.name: Development community
development.description: One country, one vote. Members fund a common treasury and vote on admitting partners and grants for members in need. It creates no automatic military obligation.

cooperation.name: Cooperation council
cooperation.description: A light voluntary council. Modest dues, majority voting and a common aid fund, without mutual defence or compulsory political alignment.

commodity_cartel.name: Commodity export cartel
commodity_cartel.description: Producers unite to coordinate resource export quotas, protect market prices and wield collective geopolitical leverage. Decisions pass by majority.

sovereign_equality.name: Sovereign equality
sovereign_equality.description: Every member governs its own path. The organization serves as a forum and common fund without imposing a single strategic alignment.

common_market.name: Common market integration
common_market.description: Shared commercial standards and customs corridors lower barriers across member borders and expand market reach.

integrated_command.name: Integrated military command
integrated_command.description: Joint logistics, shared staff planning and coordinated readiness bind members' armed forces into a single defensive shield.

sanctions_coordination.name: Coordinated economic statecraft
sanctions_coordination.description: Members align financial clearing and credit resilience to weather embargoes and enforce collective sanctions.

cartel_quotas.name: Coordinated export quotas
cartel_quotas.description: Members bind production and export limits to maintain commodity prices, expanding market reach and tax efficiency.
